author: XBOX
description:
A missing friend, a forbidden Indonesian village, a rogue agent driven by guilt.

AGNI: Village of Calamity is a cinematic survival horror, combining mind-bending terror and ritual strangeness, with Indonesian slasher style violence.

Inspired by the classic survival horror of the early Resident Evil era, with modern day 'Remedy' style storytelling and Silent Hill psychological horror.

Operating with limited resources, Agni must solve environmental puzzles and survive relentless pressure as grotesque horrors stalk her through the darkness. Every encounter is dangerous. Every bullet matters.

AGNI: Village of Calamity delivers a suffocating descent into trauma and grief, where reality is unstable, violence is brutal, and some truths should never be uncovered.

description:
Raiders of the North is the latest expansion to Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition!

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/age-of-empires-iv-raiders-of-the-north/9mzxplnlct5f

~~Two New Civilizations~~
The Vikings arrive as a relentless power shaped by raids, mobile and adaptable infantry, and the promise of glory that will echo through the ages.

The Scots stand firm as a resilient and defensive civilization.

~~Two New Biomes~~
Scottish Heathland and Tundra Summer shape the look and feel of the battlefield.

~~The Crucible Expands~~
Now playable solo or in two-player co-op.
Raiders of the North introduces four new Crucible missions with fresh challenges like Seaborne Raiders and Civil War among Scottish clans.

~~New Worlds to Conquer~~
Two new biomes, inspired by the lands shaped by the Vikings and Scots, bring the atmosphere of the North to life.

description:
Terrible Lizards is a first person horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate dangerous terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding.
 
Run, climb, swing, slide, and survive as you descend into abandoned dig sites, forgotten caverns, and monster-filled tunnels. Something down here is hunting… and it’s not alone.
 
Developed by WDR Studios, the team behind JT Music.
Out now on XBOX Game Pass.

author: XBOX
description:
The Big Bad Wolf is back, and he's got unfinished business. A murder in Fabletown. A sheriff with a dark past. A conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of 1980s New York, and every choice Bigby makes on the way to the truth will follow him.

The Wolf Among Us Remastered is the definitive edition of Telltale's acclaimed detective thriller. Every corner of Fabletown has been revisited with enhanced environments, improved character fidelity, upgraded lighting, refined animations, and remastered audio. Uncover five playable deleted scenes restored from the original 2013 production, play the entire story in the all-new Noir Mode, and explore more than 100 pieces of artwork and over an hour of developer interviews. All five original episodes are included.

For the first time, defining choices you make in The Wolf Among Us Remastered will carry forward into The Wolf Among Us 2, coming in 2027. Sign in to your Telltale Account while you play to seamlessly bring those choices into the next seas
title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered | Launch Trailer | Available Now
